answer.text: Stock prices fully reflect all past trading info (prices, volumes)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Weak-form: past prices/volumes are already reflected in current prices. Technical analysis provides no edge. **The Trap:** Weak-form says TA doesn't work; fundamental analysis may still work (semi-strong addresses this). **Cross-Exam Context:** EMH canon. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Momentum anomaly persistently challenges strict weak-form efficiency — some TA has documented edges.
